title: Sun Hung Yi

SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY.
File No. I. 0.768.

SUBJECT

Report of miscellaneous information on Chinese
local events;
also re complaints (in anonymous letters) against
Gen Lee Thum-wo, alleging expropriation of funds
for repatriation of rebel ex-soldiers -
page_data.zh:
特科档案室。
档案号 I. 0.768。

主题

关于中国地方时局杂项情报的报告；
另涉针对李徵五将军的投诉（匿名信），指控其侵吞用于遣返叛军前士兵的资金——

page_data.en:
C. I D.
I. O. REG
No. 768
Date 18/12/16
Q.M!
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

December 18th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that Sun Hung Yi 孫伊芸 the ex-Minister for the Interior has secretly arrived at Shanghai and is living at the house of the late General Huang Hsin 393 Route Ferguson Frenchtown.
The Director of the Arsenal Li Tsoong Nyoh 李宗岳 has received a letter signed by 76 ex-employers whose services have been dispensed with from time to time for economical reasons. They demand payment of $2000 to tide them over the Chinese New year and threaten to disclose extensive peculations by the administration if their demands are refused.
Certain men to the number of about 400 who claim to belong to the Koh Ming Tong and who are under Lieu roh Sun 劉汝孫 are at present trying to obtain passage tickets and money from General Li Tsing Woo 李徵五. They failed in their object. Some of them wanted $6.00 in lieu of tickets and others wanted the tickets and $6.00. in each besides while General Li's representative held to his original promise to supply passage tickets only. A number of the minor rebel leaders held a meeting at the Dong Tung Lieu 同春裡 teashop Rue Kraetzer Frenchtown late in the afternoon and decided to send two men to interview the C.S.P. two to interview Dr. Sun Yat Sen and two to the Chamber of Commerce at 9 a.m. to-day.
The City Magistrate will resume his duties to-day the period of mourning for the death of his mother being completed.

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处。
情报官登记处
第 768 号
日期 1916年12月18日
Q.M!
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处联合）
警务处，
（侦探部）

1916年12月18日

先生，

据报，前内务总长孙伊芸已秘密抵达上海，现居住于法租界费隆路393号已故黄兴将军寓所。
兵工厂总监李宗岳收到一封由76名前雇员签名的信件，这些人因经济原因陆续被解雇。他们要求支付2000美元以度过中国新年，并威胁称若要求被拒，将揭露行政当局的大规模贪污行为。
约有400名自称属于“革命党”（Koh Ming Tong，音译）且受刘汝孫统领的人，目前正试图从李徵五将军处获取船票和资金。他们未能达到目的。其中一些人想要6美元以代替船票，另一些人则想要船票外加每人6美元，而李将军的代表坚持只履行最初提供船票的承诺。一些次要的叛军首领于下午晚些时候在法租界克勒策尔路同春裡茶馆举行会议，决定派遣两人去会见公共租界巡捕房（C.S.P.），两人去会见孙中山博士，另有两人于今日上午9时去见商会。
城市知事将于今日复职，因其母丧期的守孝已结束。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
首席侦探督察。

警察总监上尉。

Form 2    31
C. I D.
I. O. REG
Shanghai Municipal Police No. 768
19/1246

Sinsa Station.
December 18 th 1916.

REPORT ON Complaints against General Lee Tsun Wo. 李徵五

Made by Det. Insp. Fitzgibbon. Forwarded by Inspector Rivers.

Sir,

My information is, that $21,916.30.
put up by General Lee Tsun Wo & Yuh Yah Ching 盧怡卿 in the
name of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce was divided by the
General & Wong Tsz Liang at 367/8 Avenue Edward VII during the
early part of last month among about 2000 stranded Revolutionary
Officers & men who were each given a Steamer Ticket with a
sum of money as towards Repatriation allowance.
At present there are no funds available. The tickets now in-
tended for issue having been bought on credit.
I am told that Advertisements circulated led the public to
believe that the proceeds of Four nights performances at the
Tie Zai Woo Dah 天然舞台 Theatre, Kiukiang Road, were to go
towards whatever expenses may be incurred in Repatriating
stranded Rebels. On the contrary when expenses are deducted
& the accounts settled about $9000.00. will be left. This sum
is to be kept for the present at the Ningpo Guild but will later
on be distributed as Repatriation allowance among the higher
Revolutionary Officers.
I am told that General Lee caused to be inserted in the Chinese
Newspapers during the past two days a statement showing how
the first sum had been expended.
It is said that the Revolutionaries are sore over the proceeds
of the Theatrical entertainments & if this matter is not
settled an attempt might be made on the life of General Lee.

yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Chief Detective Inspector.

表格 2    31
刑事侦缉处。
情报官登记处
上海警务处 第 768 号
19/1246

新闸捕房。
1916年12月18日。

关于针对李徵五将军投诉的报告。

由侦探督察菲茨吉本（Fitzgibbon）提交。经里弗斯（Rivers）督察转呈。

先生，

据我所知，由李徵五将军和盧怡卿以中华总商会名义筹集的21,916.30美元，在上个月初，由李将军和黄子良（Wong Tsz Liang，音译）在爱多亚路367/8号分发给约2000名滞留的革命军官及士兵，每人获得一张轮船票及一笔作为遣返津贴的现金。
目前无可用资金。拟发行的船票系赊购所得。
据悉，发布的广告使公众相信，九江路天然舞台四晚演出的收入将用于支付遣返滞留叛军所产生的任何费用。相反，扣除费用并结算账目后，将剩余约9000.00美元。这笔款项目前暂存于宁波同乡会，但随后将作为遣返津贴分发给高级革命军官。
据悉，李将军在过去两天内安排中文报纸刊登声明，说明第一笔款项的支出情况。
据说革命党人对戏剧演出的收入分配感到不满，如果此事得不到解决，可能会发生针对李将军生命的袭击企图。

您顺从的，
莫里斯·菲茨吉本
首席侦探督察。

Shanghai. 14 . 12 . 1916
To C.P.T.
I understand from
Mr. Wong Tsz-kiang that
the photos are to be published
in the Chinese Press.
Please enquire as to
I am not prepared
to do anything on the

表格 52
备忘录。
警务处，
工部局，
上海。1916年12月14日
致警察总监上尉。
我从黄子强（Wong Tsz-kiang，音译）先生处获悉，
这些照片将在中文报刊上发表。
请予以查询。
我不准备
仅凭这些由不满人群发送的匿名文件采取任何行动，
维持事态未决状态符合这群人的利益。
[签名]
